name: _keyframes.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  app/_keyframes.scss — shared motion keyframes: slide-in/out (toast
//  lateral travel), slide-in/out-bottom, and the SVG stroke `dash` march
//  used by loader/indicator glyphs across the shell.
//  Imported by app.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@keyframes slide-in {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(200%, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes slide-out {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(200%, 0, 0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes slide-in-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 100%, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

@keyframes slide-out-bottom {
  from {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translate3d(0, 100%, 0);
  }
}

@keyframes dash {
  to {
    stroke-dashoffset: 10;
  }
}
